Just IN: Tesla quietly expands its robotaxi fleet in Texas.

6 new unsupervised vehicles were added today, pushing the tracked total to 25 across the state. These numbers come from a crowdsourced tracker, so the real count is likely higher.

Current breakdown shows Austin at 19 vehicles, Dallas at 3 and Houston at 3. Reporting depends on riders submitting license plates, and even competing fleets like Waymo are undercounted in the same system.

What stands out is the scale sitting in the background. There are staging lots with around 80 robotaxis each, ready to be deployed. That suggests this rollout can accelerate fast once Tesla flips the switch.

🚨 JUST IN: The first Tesla Semi has rolled off the new high-volume production line at the dedicated factory in Nevada! 🎉
Huge milestone for electric trucking. Tesla is ramping toward volume production in 2026, with a target capacity of up to 50,000 units per year at the Giga Semi facility next to Giga Nevada.
Key Facts about the Tesla Semi:
•  Two variants:
•  Standard Range: ~325 miles range at full 82,000 lb GCW.
•  Long Range: ~500 miles range (at 82k lb GCW).
•  Powertrain: 3 independent electric motors on rear axles, up to 800 kW drive power.
•  Efficiency: ~1.7 kWh per mile — dramatically lower operating costs vs. diesel (often 60-70% savings).
•  Charging: Megawatt Charging System (MCS), up to 1.2 MW, ~60% range in 30 minutes.
•  Other highlights: Autonomy-ready, ePTO, strong acceleration/safety (regenerative braking), and designed for million-mile durability.
This is a game-changer for Class 8 trucking: zero emissions, lower TCO, and massive scalability. Congrats to the Tesla Semi team! ⚡🚛

NEWS: Elon Musk continues to spar with OpenAI's attorney over questioning style on day 3.

Proceedings resumed with Elon Musk clashing again with OpenAI's lawyer William Savitt. 

After Savitt said he was asking a simple question, Elon Musk fired back: "Your questions are definitionally complex, not simple. It is a lie to say they are simple."

Savitt pressed Elon Musk on his desire to control his companies, including Tesla and SpaceX. 

The two sparred over details of his current and future Tesla ownership, including stock options reported in financial filings.
